decisions.decision: prefetch={true} on the sidebar Link, NOT experimental staleTimes
decisions.rationale: Measured in a production build: 6 -> 2 RSC requests, stable API. It only became safe after use-delete-task was made to write the cache; before that a cached navigation resurrected a deleted task. staleTimes.dynamic gave 6 -> 4 and needed an experimental flag.

decisions.decision: use-delete-task writes the query cache like every sibling
decisions.rationale: It was the ONLY mutation hook doing zero cache work (0 setQueryData calls vs 2-3 in every sibling), leaning entirely on refresh(). That made the whole board route uncacheable. Recorded as ADR tech/0030 rule 4.

decisions.decision: local/prefer-is-nil ships at WARN, not error
decisions.rationale: 175 pre-existing comparisons across 77 files; erroring fails the build on day one. No --max-warnings is set so lint still exits 0. Promotion tracked as its own todo.

decisions.decision: The sign-in field problem is autofill + a doubled message, not the counter
decisions.rationale: The counter cannot serve an EMPTY required field, and the sign-in password passes no characterLimit at all. User accepted all four proposed fixes.
